text: `(*Command).MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(flagNames...)` merges persistent flags, verifies every named flag exists, and annotates each with the space-joined group under `cobra_annotation_mutually_exclusive`; it panics for a missing flag or annotation error. Repeated calls create separate groups, so a flag may belong to multiple groups (`flag_groups.go:25-29,63-78`).
